description: Following weeks of speculation, Apple on Wednesday finally dropped the date of its upcoming hardware launch event. The showcase, which carries the tagline ‘Surprise and shine’, is all set to kick off in the second week of September. While the Cupertino-based tech giant remains tight lipped on the upcoming announcements, the rumour mill has pointed towards an annual iPhone refresh, with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models being introduced. However, that is not all; several more products across various categories are also anticipated.
title: Apple 'Surprise and Shine' Event Set for September 9; iPhone 18 Series, Apple Watch Series 12 Expected
MSI Cyborg 15 Max, Cyborg 15: What the Extra Power and Cooling Actually Buy You

description: Rockstar Games has finally acknowledged Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks, calling them "heartbreaking" for the development team. The studio said it was unfortunate that the intended GTA 6 experience may be impacted by spoilers following leaks. GTA 6 leaks surfaced last week and have continued to reveal gameplay footage from the title.
title: Rockstar Games Says GTA 6 Leaks Have Been 'Heartbreaking', Promises More Details Soon

description: There are multiple printers in the market that cater to the needs of business owners. However, business owners often look for reliable laser printers that can work without hassle daily, as a one-time investment. HP is one of the most reputable brands in this price segment and category of printers. The HP 303dw Auto Duplex WiFi Laser printer is known for offering long-term reliability to users, which helps proprietors reduce business costs over time. Another offering in the lineup is the HP 323dnw Auto Duplex WiFi Laser printer, which offers similar connected functionalities as the HP 303dw.
title: One-Time Investment Printers That Last for Years: Reliable Laser Printers for Businesses

description: Telegram’s latest update adds new tools for group and channel owners, developers and users. Owners can create private welcome messages for new members, while developers can add interactive buttons to messages and build temporary experiences. The rich text editor now supports documents, files and music within messages. Telegram has also added signatures and comments for collectible gifts purchased through its Marketplace. A new placeholder helps users update older app versions when they cannot display newly introduced features.
title: Telegram 13th Anniversary Update Brings Welcome Messages, Interactive Buttons, and More

description: Revolut has begun rolling out EURR, a euro-backed stablecoin, to select customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal. Issued by Bridge Building S.A., the token is designed to comply with the EU’s MiCA framework and will initially be available on Ethereum. Revolut plans to expand EURR across the EEA and support additional blockchain networks during 2026.
title: Revolut Introduces MiCA-Compliant EURR Stablecoin to European Crypto Services

description: Instagram on Tuesday announced the launch of its new First Draft feature. The feature is currently rolling out to the Instagram for iOS app. The company says that the feature helps creators “get past the starting point” of editing their Reels. The new First Draft feature will be available within the Instagram app. As the name suggests, the new functionality is capable of generating the first draft of a Reel for users. Instagram users can select a clip on their iPhone and use First Draft to generate an edited version of the same.
title: Instagram First Draft Launched With the Ability to Automatically Trim Clips for Reels

description: Oppo Find X10 series is tipped to use a new Tianma OLED panel when it launches in China in September. The display could offer 2,000 nits of global brightness, narrower four-sided bezels and 95 percent BT.2020 colour gamut coverage. It is also expected to use N1 luminescent material and produce 5.5 percent beneficial red light. The panel is linked to Tianma’s Tiangong Screen 2.0 technology, which supports 0.01-nit brightness and improved low-brightness uniformity. Oppo has yet to confirm these details.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Display Features Leaked Again Ahead of Expected September Launch

description: Bitwise has introduced three Automated Token Portfolios that let eligible investors outside the US copy professionally managed stock portfolio models using Coinbase’s tokenised US stocks. The portfolios can be held in self-custody wallets, while Glider handles trades and rebalancing. Bitwise will charge a 0.15 percent methodology fee, excluding transaction and Glider fees.
title: Bitwise Launches Three Automated Portfolios Using Coinbase Tokenised US Stocks

description: Perplexity has launched Portable Computer, a new version of its Perplexity Computer AI agent. Perplexity’s Portable Computer is currently rolling out to Pro and Max subscribers on the Nvidia DGX Spark and will be available on Nvidia RTX GPU PCs soon. The company says that the first release has been released to Linux devices, and it plans to roll out support for Windows devices soon. The company’s Portable Computer builds on its recently launched AI agent, which is capable of running Perplexity Computer entirely on edge devices, allowing users to analyse data, synthesise files, and run complex workflows locally.
title: Perplexity’s Portable Computer Launched, Brings Cloud-Like AI Agent Capabilities to Edge Devices

description: iPhone Ultra, Apple's first book-style foldable, will feature a redesigned internal layout, according to the leaked images of the phone's motherboard. The image of the phone’s motherboard shows the unreleased Apple Silicon A20 Pro chipset placed next to the DRAM, instead of being stacked on top of the chip. The A20 Pro chip and DRAM of the iPhone Ultra will reportedly be connected via a redistribution layer. Usually, the SoC and DRAM are stacked on top of each other with a conventional interposer. The redistribution layer is said to eliminate the need for an additional silicon interposer, as found on traditional designs, as it is built right into the package. This will reportedly help the foldable offer improved thermal performance.
title: iPhone Ultra Could Feature Redesigned Internal Layout as Purported Images of Motherboard Surface Online

description: Tecno Spark Go 3 Pro could arrive in India later this week, with a tipster claiming that the smartphone will debut on August 28. The handset is also expected to offer an IP69 rating and has appeared in leaked images showing its design and testing process. Earlier certification listings suggested that the device is in development and could feature a 5,100mAh battery. The Pro model is expected to build on the Spark Go 3, which launched in India earlier this year.
title: Tecno Spark Go 3 Pro India Launch Date, Design, Key Features Leaked Online

description: Real-world asset deposits across decentralised lending and trading platforms reached $7.4 billion in the second quarter of 2026, more than triple the level recorded a year earlier, according to CoinShares. The increase came as overall DeFi deposits declined 15 percent year-on-year, while spot trading of tokenised assets rose 220 percent despite a 70 percent fall in broader decentralised exchange volumes.
title: RWA Deposits Rise Sharply on DeFi Platforms Despite 15% Drop in Overall DeFi Deposits

description: Realme C100i 4G is set to launch in India on August 27, with its retail packaging revealing the RMX5399 model number and other details. The phone is tipped to cost Rs. 14,999 for the 4GB RAM and 64GB storage variant and could feature a 6.75-inch 120Hz display. The phone may also include a Unisoc T7250 chipset, 6,500mAh battery, 15W charging, 8-megapixel rear camera and Realme UI 7 based on Android 16. The Indian version may differ from its global counterpart.
title: Realme C100i 4G Retail Box Surfaces Ahead of India Launch, Key Details Revealed

description: Ubisoft has announced Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Tactics, a single-player turn-based tactics game coming to PC and consoles. The title was revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Life. Rainbow Six Tactics can be wishlisted on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.
title: Ubisoft Reveals Rainbow Six Tactics at Gamescom Opening Night Live

description: The launch of the Vivo X500 series was recently confirmed in China. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the brand has now begun revealing details about its upcoming lineup, which will comprise Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max. A company executive has teased major camera upgrades on the Vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max. Both models are confirmed to improved periscope telephoto cameras compared to their predecessors, alongside CIPA 7.0-rated stabilisation and improved autofocus capabilities.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Confirmed to Feature 200-Megapixel Zeiss Telephoto Camera; X500 Pro to Get 64-Megapixel Sensor

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra computer-aided design (CAD) renders have surfaced online, hinting at the phone’s design. The handset is shown to feature a significantly different rear camera module compared to its predecessor. Instead of the pill-shaped deco, the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra appears with a horizontally aligned rectangular camera island. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra is shown in a grey colourway. The leaked renders also suggest that the flagship Galaxy S series phone might carry a triple rear camera system and an LED flash, instead of a quad camera unit.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Design, Colourway Spotted in Leaked CAD Renders

description: Redmi 17C 5G has debuted in Singapore with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC and a 6.9-inch display offering a 120Hz refresh rate. The smartphone comes with 4GB RAM and up to 128GB storage, while its Memory Extension feature can increase RAM to 8GB. It also includes a 50-megapixel rear camera, 8-megapixel selfie camera and 6,000mAh battery. The handset supports 33W charging, carries an IP64 rating and runs Xiaomi HyperOS 3. Xiaomi has not confirmed its India launch yet.
title: Redmi 17C 5G Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: CMF Buds Neo true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds which were announced on 20 August in India will go on sale today. The earbuds offer 35dB Adaptive active noise cancellation, spatial audio and customisable EQ settings among other features and are priced at Rs. 1,999 in India.
title: CMF Buds Neo Goes on Sale in India for the First Time: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers

description: Krafton India on Wednesday released a fresh set of redeem codes for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). The BGMI redeem codes, which work for a limited time, enable players to unlock limited-time in-game rewards for free. The developer has released a list of 50 redeem codes, which players can claim through BGMI's official redemption website. In recent weeks, Krafton has been regularly dropping BGMI redeem codes, commemorating the game's 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for August 26: Claim Suave Master Set and Other Free Rewards This Way

description: Realme P4s 5G has been launched in India with a price tag of Rs. 34,999. The smartphone features a flagship-grade 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) Samsung M14 AMOLED display, delivering up to a 144Hz refresh rate and up to 6,500 nits of peak brightness. With the Realme P4s 5G, the company has fixed a major problem its recently launched handsets have been suffering from, which is low-quality display. Moreover, the new P series phone gets an 8,000mAh battery, which offers sub-par battery life. However, the handset features an adequately powerful MediaTek chipset and a capable rear camera system.
title: Realme P4s 5G Review: A Mid-Ranger With a Flagship-Grade Display

description: Philips S7221 has appeared on an Amazon microsite ahead of its India launch, revealing several details about the upcoming smartphone. The handset will offer 6GB or 8GB of RAM with up to 256GB of storage and will support 5G connectivity. It will feature a 120Hz display, dual stereo speakers and a 64-megapixel AI-assisted rear camera. The phone will also include a 16-megapixel front camera and IP64-rated dust and splash resistance. Philips has not yet announced its price or launch date.
title: Philips Set to Launch New 5G-Supported Smartphone in India, Amazon Availability Confirmed

description: WhatsApp has announced that more than one billion users have enabled passkeys for their WhatsApp accounts. Adding to this, the tech giant says that users who have their WhatsApp accounts logged in on both Android and iOS can now add more than one passkey to their account. On top of this, the instant messaging platform has added a new ability to its two-step verification process. The company has announced that users can now set up a full password, which is longer and alphanumeric, while also containing special characters. Lastly, WhatsApp has announced a new, smarter call screening feature for WhatsApp for Android.
title: WhatsApp Gets Advanced Passkey, 2FA and Call Screening Features to Enhance Security, Privacy

description: Oppo’s A7 Pro 5G has now surfaced on a Brazilian certification site giving us our first glance at the yet to be released smartphone. The listing contains photographs of the device from different angles, showcasing a design that appears very different from the recently launched Oppo A7 Pro Max.
title: Oppo A7 Pro 5G Leak Reveals Capsule-Shaped Camera Module and 8,000mAh Battery

description: iQOO 16 is widely believed to be unveiled as the company’s latest flagship smartphone later this year. Before its making its global debut, the purported handset is expected to be first launched in China. While the Vivo sub-brand has yet to confirm the smartphone, it has now appeared on a benchmarking site. The listing not only sheds light on some of the iQOO 16’s internal hardware, but also confirms its moniker.
title: iQOO 16 Geekbench Listing Reveals Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Performance Figures

description: CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered, featuring improved visuals, performance, and gameplay. The remastered version of the game will launch as a free upgrade for existing The Witcher 3 owners on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X next month. It will also be available on Nintendo Switch 2.
title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered Announced at Gamescom Opening Night Live, Launch Set for Next Month

description: Realme P4s 5G has been launched in India as the launched in India as the latest addition to the company's P4 lineup. The handset is set to go on sale in India on September 3 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart. The Realme P4s 5G will be available for purchase in Electric Cyan and Titanium Grey colour options. The Realme P4s 5G is a dual-SIM smartphone that ships with the Realme UI 7.0, which is based on Android 16. The phone sports a 6.8-inch 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) Samsung M14 AMOLED display. It is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset.
title: Realme P4s 5G Launched in India With 8,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin is consolidating after briefly crossing $81,000, with ETF inflows and improving liquidity supporting the broader market. However, large holders are booking profits, while investors await US PCE inflation and GDP data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $79,000 as Profit-Taking and US Data Put Rally to Test

description: Nothing has been steadily expanding its portfolio of true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones. The company recently debuted the Nothing Ear (3a) as the latest pair of affordable earbuds in select markets. Now, the UK-based brand appears to be gearing up to introduce another TWS offering. According to a report, a new pair of wireless earbuds have been spotted on a certification platform, which not only confirms their development, but also provides an early look at the charging case and its battery specifications.
title: Nothing Buds Pro 2 Reportedly Spotted on FCC Database; Battery Capacity, Charging Case Design Revealed

description: The Poco F9 series is all set to be launched in the global markets soon. The company recently confirmed that its upcoming performance-focussed lineup will include two models — Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra, with the vanilla F9 variant unlikely to debut. Both models expected to be based on the Redmi K100 series smartphones sold in China. The Xiaomi sub-brand has now revealed that the Poco F9 series will be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship mobile chipset.
title: Poco F9 Ultra Confirmed to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip; Pro Model to Use Binned Version
